text:
jon_ops: Heads up — embeddings cluster in eu-west1 is hitting 503s for a subset of customers, retrying spikes. I drafted a small hotpatch (kv-cache TTL bump + guard) that fixes it. Need express approvals to push out of staging into a short window now.
elaine_release: Can you paste the change and the rollout plan? also pinging @sam_sre for smoke.
jon_ops: Change: bump kv cache TTL from 30s -> 90s and add a defensive null-check in embed pipeline. Image tag: `redwood/embeds-service:2026-03-23-hotfix-a`. Rollout: canary 5% -> 20% (15m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (monitor 30m). Rollback: redeploy previous image `redwood/embeds-service:2026-03-18-prod` and immediate traffic-pin.
ivy_pm: Customer SLOs impacted, execs notified. Need one engineer + one SRE + release lead to ack for expedited window.
sam_sre: I can cover SRE signoff if smoke passes. What are the smoke checks?
jon_ops: Smoke: 1) embed inference end-to-end (baseline input) 2) KV cache hit ratio sanity 3) p99 latency under 600ms for eu-west1 control group. I ran them in staging: all green, attached logs snippet: ```2026-03-23T18:02Z embed_ok=true latency_p99=412ms kv_hit=0.72```
elaine_release: Release lead ack from me if infra approves. Will prepare release note stub: "hotfix: embeddings 503 mitigation, TTL and guard". Also set `pin: true` for the image so dedicated pools don't auto-update.
sam_sre: Running quick smoke in prod shadow now. If green, +1 SRE. ETA 6m.
releasebot: deploybot requested: `promote redwood/embeds-service:2026-03-23-hotfix-a` -> canary slot eu-west1-embed-canary. Schedule window: immediate, 45m total.
deploybot: Starting canary deploy -> eu-west1-embed-canary (5%)
`cmd: deployctl promote --service embeds --image redwood/embeds-service:2026-03-23-hotfix-a --target canary --region eu-west1 --weight 5`
jon_ops: smoke shadow run results: embed_ok=true latency_p99=430ms kv_hit=0.70. no errors in logs for 5m.
sam_sre: smoke looks good. I'm +1. also sanity-checked tracing for the null-check branch — no new exceptions.
ivy_pm: +1 from PM (stakeholder notified). go ahead, but enforce traffic ramp rules.
elaine_release: +1 release. pinned image in release manifest and added a brief blurb to the release notes. Also toggled `dedicated_autoupdate=false` for relevant pools.
deploybot: Increasing canary to 20% -> eu-west1-embed-canary
`cmd: deployctl set-weight --service embeds --region eu-west1 --weight 20`
jon_ops: Observability: errors down 88% in canary; latencies steady. Dev logs: minor retry spikes only.
sam_sre: Monitoring: synthetic checks pass, no elevated errors in 10m window. I'm happy to let it ramp to 50%.
elaine_release: Affirmative. Release notes final: "Hotfix: fix transient 503s from embed pipeline by extending KV cache TTL and adding defensive null-check; staged rollout and pin applied." I'll post the release note after 100% deploy.
deploybot: Increasing canary to 50% -> command issued.
jon_ops: Quick sanity: manual embed traffic sample ok, error rates low.
sam_sre: 50% stable for 12m. I approve full roll. :white_check_mark:
releasebot: Initiating final traffic shift to 100% over next 5m.
deploybot: Rollout complete — embeds-service image `2026-03-23-hotfix-a` now at 100% in eu-west1. All health checks passing.
ivy_pm: Thanks team. Please follow up with postmortem note and link to the incident chat for customer comms.
elaine_release: I'll publish release note + changelog and tag the support ticket. Good catch, team. :thumbsup:
jon_ops: Reverting plan kept handy. But no rollback needed. Leaving pin in place for 24h.
sam_sre: I'll keep monitoring alerts for 2 hours and then hand back to normal ops.
releasebot: Incident thread closed (temp). Logs and deploy artifacts: https://internal.redwood/ci/artifacts/1837772468
jon_ops: thanks everyone — closing here. :shipit:
